title: StateImportItemCarriedPayload

importId.description: The import: the command id of the stateImport.run that applied it, in lowercase.

sourceKey.description: The source data folder's canonical path on the environment's machine: symbolic links resolved.

store.description: The source store or organisation decision kind, including banks, banks.default, provider-sessions and organisation.archive/pin/group/group-source/membership/draft.

sourceId.description: The item's id in its store, or its natural identity where the store gives it none.

kind.description: The owning service kind for a carried Bank/default, instruction, Account/default, provider Session, archive or active decision, pin, Group/membership, draft, Forge account, Key-manager connection, dev site, page policy, a disabled local Routine, tracked Skill repository or Account Skill choice, or the favourite models made of the models chosen in the source.

sourceDirectory.description: The canonical listed Claude directory retained as an import source for an Account or Session mapping, including a secondary directory. No credentials.

targetId.description: The target held by its owning service: a Bank, Account, Session, Group or instruction id, a dev-site host pattern, connection id or setting key.

origin.description: Always import: the target was written by a state import.

description: state-import.item-carried: a source item was carried: its folder, store and id there, its kind, the target its owning service made of it, the import that carried it, and origin import.
